name: delta-bars
title: Delta Bars
description: Diverging daily delta ribbon for a pair of rivals — bars rise above the zero midline when A leads, drop below when B leads.

meta.question: Who is ahead today, and by how much?
meta.whenToUse: Tracking the day-by-day lead between exactly two rivals where the sign and streaks of the gap matter more than absolute volumes (head-to-head races, A/B momentum).
meta.antiUse: Not for more than 2 rivals or for absolute magnitudes — use race lines or stacked forms instead.
